title: In-demo navigation to /demo after a deep-link boot strands the demo home on a permanent skeleton (r2-B2 fix covers /dashboard only)
evidence: routes.Demo, True -> handle_browser_change(model, uri, route)  // no re-seed (r2#12 fix); then gate: let eff = case route, updated_model.vacancies { routes.Dashboard, NotAsked -> ... }  // routes.Demo unmatched; enter_demo: vacancies: case route { routes.Demo | routes.Dashboard -> Loading; _ -> NotAsked }; dashboard.gleam: NotAsked, _ | Loading, _ -> view_loading_skeleton(); breadcrumb.gleam: True -> "/demo"
detail: Boot on /vacancies/v-maples (PR-touted shareable entry): vacancies=NotAsked. Clicking the breadcrumb 'Dashboard' home (links /demo in demo) hits routes.Demo, True; the fetch gate only matches routes.Dashboard, so no fetch fires and the demo home skeletons forever. r2's unconditional re-seed masked this; the r2-B2 fix missed the /demo route.
recommended_fix: Match routes.Demo alongside routes.Dashboard in the dashboard fetch gate (and Loading-setter) in handle_browser_change.

title: Demo exit via the banner CTA from a dirty edit page: state cleared first, then the unsaved-changes guard cancels the exit — stranded on login at the demo edit URL
evidence: True -> handle_browser_change(model |> model.clear_demo_state, uri, route)  // then inside handle_browser_change: case model.vacancy_edit_has_unsaved_changes { True -> #(Model(..updated_model, route: model.route, show_unsaved_changes_prompt: True, ...), modem.replace("/vacancies/" <> edit_id <> "/edit", None, None)) }
detail: update/2 sets vacancy_edit_has_unsaved_changes regardless of demo_mode. Editing a demo vacancy then clicking 'Create your vacancy →' (/signup): clear_demo_state wipes demo first, the guard then cancels the navigation — demo_mode False, store None, auth NotAsked, URL back on /vacancies/v-maples/edit, prompt flag set but the prompt renders only inside the edit page, which login.view_login replaces.
recommended_fix: Run the public-route exit after the navigation guards, or bypass the unsaved-changes guard when exiting demo (demo edits are disposable by design).

title: enter_demo still clobbers a live landlord session and exit downgrades auth to NotAsked with no session re-check (r2 finding 16 still present)
evidence: auth: Success(landlord), csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token", demo_mode: True,  // enter_demo; clear_demo_state: demo_mode: False, demo_store: None, auth: NotAsked,  // no auth_api.check_session dispatched on either exit path
detail: A logged-in landlord who hand-types /demo (full reload boots demo, skipping check_session) loses their SPA session to the mock landlord; exiting shows them logged out until a real login, though their cookie session is still valid server-side.
recommended_fix: On demo exit, dispatch auth_api.check_session(ApiReturnedSession) instead of hard-downgrading auth to NotAsked.

title: Demo boot skips the visibility-refresh listener and localStorage hydrations for the tab's lifetime (r2 finding 30 still present)
evidence: True -> { let #(demo_model, demo_eff) = enter_demo(base_model, route) #(demo_model, effect.batch([modem.init(BrowserChangedUrl), demo_eff])) }  // no listen_visibility_refresh(), no hydrate_dismissed_sweep_nudges_effect(), no hydrate_refcheck_explainer_dismissed_effect()
detail: A demo-first boot that later exits and logs in via SPA (no reload) never installs the multi-tab policy-sync listener or the sweep-nudge/refcheck-dismissal hydrations for the rest of the tab's lifetime.
recommended_fix: Install the listener + hydrations on demo exit, or on first real auth success.

title: Edit deep-link boot renders the empty editable form for the first frame — enter_demo never sets vacancy_edit_loading (r2-B4's parenthesised half)
detail: The r2-B4 fix added the get_for_edit arm but not the loading flag: /vacancies/v-maples/edit boot paints the full empty form for one render before the demo response populates it.
recommended_fix: Set vacancy_edit_loading: True in enter_demo for the VacancyEdit route (as the r2 finding recommended).

title: Seed failure falls back to the Landing route without navigating — URL stays /demo with no user feedback
evidence: Error(_) -> #(Model(..model, route: routes.Landing, demo_mode: False, demo_store: None), effect.none())
detail: If demo_store.seed() fails (fixture decode drift), the model route flips to Landing but no modem.replace fires, so landing content renders at /demo and nothing tells the user what happened.
recommended_fix: Pair the fallback with modem.replace("/", None, None) (and optionally an error toast).
